name: The Highlight at Houston Center
summary: The Highlight at Houston Center is a renovated downtown Houston plaza offering an elevated mix of upscale and casual dining, entertainment including mini-golf, and wellness services. Formerly The Shops at Houston Center, this reimagined destination provides convenient access to restaurants, medical offices, and local businesses in one central, beautifully designed space.
demographics: The Highlight at Houston Center attracts a diverse mix of downtown Houston professionals, office workers, and urban residents, primarily aged 25-54 with middle to upper-middle income levels. The trade area serves the central business district with a high concentration of white-collar workers seeking convenient lunch options, after-work dining, and entertainment. Visitors typically exhibit time-conscious shopping patterns, favoring quick-service dining during weekdays and more leisurely experiences on weekends, with a preference for quality casual dining and experiential amenities like mini-golf.
description: The Highlight at Houston Center represents a complete transformation of the former Shops at Houston Center, reimagined as a vibrant mixed-use destination in the heart of downtown Houston. Located at 1200 McKinney Street, this renovated plaza has been reinvigorated to offer Houstonians an elevated daily experience combining dining, entertainment, shopping, and wellness services all in one convenient, beautifully designed space. The center features an impressive array of dining options ranging from quick bites to upscale experiences, including Pappas Bros Steakhouse, Doozo's Dumplings, Chick-fil-A, and Otto's BBQ, alongside entertainment venues featuring mini-golf and gathering spaces perfect for happy hours and special occasions. Beyond dining and entertainment, The Highlight serves the practical needs of downtown workers and residents with wellness services including Berkeley Eye Institute, Kelsey Seybold medical offices and pharmacy, and GNC, plus shopping options for everyday essentials. With its central location and diverse tenant mix, The Highlight has successfully positioned itself as the go-to destination for upgrading any day of the week, whether grabbing lunch between meetings on a Tuesday or celebrating with friends on Saturday night.
